data.name: Raise Scorpion
data.description: 1/day, you may cause a dead body within 60 ft. to transform into a fiendish giant scorpion under your mental control. This transformation lasts for %1 rounds, after which the scorpion returns to its original corpse form. This is a polymorph effect.|TL
